study: real semantic retrieval and recommendation v1
purpose: Separate real-data semantic model quality, ANN numerical fidelity, and actual integrated-versus-cascade costs.

ir.final_label_policy: No checkpoint, instruction, probe, dimension or hyperparameter selection on final evaluation labels.
ir.ranker_pool: Label-independent candidates; common-pool quality and actual-retriever quality reported separately.

recommendation.clock_policy: Whole(user,time_ms) recorded-clock envelopes plus declared-date periods; quarantine cutoff crossings.
recommendation.history_policy: Frozen admitted-training exposure items only, upper<=target lower, no outcome-conditioned selection.
recommendation.metadata_contract: Retrospective fixed semantic metadata. Captions released 2026 are not historically versioned; exact exposure/feedback clocks unestablished.
recommendation.data_license: Conservatively comply with the original archive CC-BY-SA-4.0; supplement declares CC-BY-4.0.

embeddings.silver_native4096: Unsupported by pinned source; full-dimensional exact and FAISS ablation must not be relabeled SilverTorch.

ann.latency_query_sampling: Predetermined varying query batches from the full panel, shared across backends.
ann.oracle: Chunked FP32 inner-product over the identical stored learned vectors; TF32 disabled.
ann.no_loss_claim: Both geometric ANN overlap and real judged relevance metrics are required.

ranking.architecture_control: Exactly the same candidate IDs, weights, scoring, precision and final top-k for GPU-resident integrated and measured separate-stage local cascade.
ranking.time: Separate offline encoding/build/training, online query encoding, retrieval, movement, tokenization and reranking.
ranking.mfu: Do not invent MFU; report wall time, real/padded tokens per second, pairs per second, memory, GPU utilization and profiler-derived compute only when justified.
